spec.scope: Boss-held offensive debuff — benefits every ally's damage of every category while the window is open; not scoped to sakura-suzuhara's own hits and not a crit/charge-scoped stat.
spec.durationSemantics: 'for 5 sec' is literal wall-clock — durationSec:5, NOT durationShots. Re-procs refresh/reapply per engine overwrite rules (same caster slot).
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount:120 (counts landed ROUNDS; SMG hitsPerShot=1 so rounds == trigger pulls). Cumulative across reloads. NOT lastBullet — it numerically coincides at base (ammo 120) but diverges under any max-ammo/reload modifier, and hitCount is what the prose states.
spec.targetSet: 'Affects the target(s)' = enemy (the boss). Emitted as a boss-held buffApply with casterIdx===null AND targetIdx===null per the harness note.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Taxonomy trap #4 inverted: encoding 'Damage Taken ▲' as a buff on self/allies (an attackDamagePct-style team buff) instead of a boss-held damageTakenPct debuff — or encoding the trigger as lastBullet, which silently breaks if ammo/reload economy ever shifts.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Filter buffApply for stat 'damageTakenPct' value 17.18: casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null (boss-held), first application at the frame of the 120th LANDED round (≈6s of firing at effective SMG cadence, definitely not t=0). A/B via withPatchedOverride stripping the skill1 block: TEAMMATES' totals (crown, helm, the B3 carry) must each drop when the block is removed — under the nearest-wrong self/team-buff encoding only the carrier (or only buff-recipients' srcSlot damage via a wrong bucket) moves, and buffApply would carry a real targetIdx.
spec.inertness: Must NOT appear as a buff on any ally row; must NOT apply at t=0; must not double-stack with skill2's 'Damage Taken ▼' line (different mechanic entirely).

spec.scope: A received-healing amplifier on allies — a stat with no StatKey in the effect schema and no HP-amount model in the engine (heal effects carry no magnitude).
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount:60 (rounds), cumulative across reloads — would proc twice per skill1 cycle if it were modeled.
spec.targetSet: 2 allies with lowest HP percentage → alliesLowestHp{count:2} (engine stand-in: leftmost 2, documented as indeterminate at scope lock).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoding it as a 'heal' EFFECT that fires every 60 hits — which would spuriously emit recovery events and feed on-recovery consumers (crown-class kits) at SMG hit cadence, a massive over-credit. It is a stat buff on the recipients, not a heal.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: In the control fixture (crown B2 present), NO recovery-trigger activations may be attributable to a 60-hit-cadence source: crown's on-recovery buffApply stream must be identical with this line present vs stripped. totals() for every unit identical under A/B.
spec.inertness: Zero damage movement for anyone; zero recovery events; zero buffApply with any damage-relevant stat from this line.

spec.scope: DEFENSIVE damage-reduction on the 2 lowest-HP% ALLIES. The boss deals no damage in v1, so this is inert. Critically: despite sharing the words 'Damage Taken' with skill1, this is the opposite mechanic — an ally-protective ▼, not the boss-held offensive ▲.
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount:120 (rounds) — same cadence as skill1's boss debuff, which makes the conflation trap below extra plausible (both fire on the same frame).
spec.targetSet: 2 allies with lowest HP percentage → alliesLowestHp{count:2}; NOT the enemy.
spec.nearestWrongModel: THE trap of this kit: folding this line into the boss-held damageTakenPct channel — either as a second +14.97% boss debuff (over-credits the whole team ~15%) or as a −14.97% on the boss (cuts the whole team ~15%). Both misreads fire on the exact same 120-hit frame as skill1, so a magnitude-only check can't catch them.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: At each 120-hit proc frame there must be EXACTLY ONE boss-held buffApply with stat 'damageTakenPct' and its value must be exactly 17.18 (skill1's) — never 14.97, never −14.97, never a stacked 32.15 effective window. A/B stripping only this skill2 block: every unit's totals() unchanged.
spec.inertness: Must move no damage at all; must not open, extend, deepen, or shrink skill1's boss-debuff window.

spec.scope: Heal-over-time. The HP magnitude (10.03% of caster's final Max HP) is inherently unmodeled (heal effects carry no amount), but the recovery EVENTS are the modeled substance — they drive teammates' 'recovery' triggers (taxonomy #4: never skip a heal on isolation grounds; crown-class consumers feed on it, and crown IS in the control fixture).
spec.durationSemantics: 'every 1 sec for 10 sec' = a heal effect with ticks:10, intervalSec:1 — TEN recovery events spread over 10s, NOT the back-compatible default ticks:1 single instant event.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast — her OWN Burst I cast, never fullBurstEnter. She is Burst I with a 40s cooldown sharing the stage with liter in the control fixture, so 'fires on any team FB' vs 'fires only on rotations she casts' diverge on essentially every rotation.
spec.targetSet: 2 allies with lowest HP percentage → alliesLowestHp{count:2} (leftmost-2 stand-in). Exactly 2 recipients — not all allies.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Two plausible misreads: (a) ticks defaulted to 1 — a single recovery event at cast, so an on-recovery consumer applies once and lapses instead of being refreshed ~1/s across the 10s window; (b) keyed to fullBurstEnter, emitting heals on rotations where liter (not sakura-suzuhara) carried B1.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: First confirm she actually casts: count burstCast events for her slug (>0) — with liter co-eligible at B1 and a 40s vs 20s cooldown, first-ready selection may starve her; the fixture/assertion must establish her casts before anything downstream. Then, per sakura-suzuhara burstCast: exactly 10 recovery events land on exactly 2 distinct targetIdx values over the following ~10s (frames spaced ~60 apart), and crown's recovery-triggered buffApply stream shows ~1/s refreshes for 10s after her cast — vs ONE apply-then-lapse under ticks:1, and vs heals appearing on FB entries she did not cast under the fullBurstEnter misread.
spec.inertness: No recovery events on Full Bursts whose B1 cast was liter's; never more than 2 heal recipients per cast; no direct damage from the burst itself.

loadBearingSet: burst:heal ticks:10 recovery-event stream on burstCast

burst: Recovers 10.03% of the skill user's final Max HP (heal MAGNITUDE — the engine models recovery events, not HP amounts)

notes: Three reconciliation points for the driver. (1) THE kit-specific trap is the twin 'Damage Taken' lines: skill1 is a boss-held offensive ▲17.18% (enemy target, casterIdx/targetIdx null) while skill2's ▼14.97% is a defensive ally buff that must stay fully inert — both proc on the same 120th-hit frame, so tests must pin the boss-held channel to exactly one apply of exactly 17.18 per proc, or a conflated encoding (±14.97 on the boss) passes any coarser check. (2) Fixture validity: she is Burst I, cd 40s; controlComp fixes liter at B1 and the carry at B3 — a Burst I unit cannot sit the carry slot as authored, and even placed elsewhere she competes with liter (20s cd) under first-ready selection, so any burst-heal assertion must FIRST assert her burstCast count > 0 (else the heal tests are vacuously green). Expect the shared-prior misread here to be fullBurstEnter-keying, which hides the starvation problem entirely. (3) Cadence arithmetic for skill1 uptime: 120 landed rounds at effective SMG cadence (~20/s after frame quantization) ≈ 6s of firing + 81-frame reload ≈ 7.3–7.5s proc period → ~65–70% debuff uptime; first apply ≈ t≈6s, and asserting 'not at t=0' plus 'roughly one proc per magazine cycle' catches both an interval-trigger approximation and a lastBullet re-keying (which coincides at base ammo 120 but is the wrong primitive).
